reapack.name: LV1_Track_Importer.lua
reapack.desc: LV1 Track Importer - connect to a Waves LV1 mixer and create Reaper tracks

version.author: malik-malassis
version.changelog: - Track creation and update can no longer leave REAPER's UI refresh disabled or an undo block open if they fail partway through. - Shift-click a checkbox to select a range of tracks. - Warns when the selection needs more hardware inputs than the audio device actually provides. - Replayed capture files (--mock) are now flagged in the window.
